sourceRefs.locator: Chapter 5, DK Area G Section, c5.22 and Plate XIX, Block 8, room 50, large brick covers in situ and provisional Late I assignment.
Abstract, broad Indus urban phase around 2600–1900 BCE and discussion of collective action and political organization.

note.de: In Block 8, Raum 50 fand die Grabung eine mit großen Ziegeln abgedeckte Rinne. Der Zahlenrahmen bezeichnet die Indus-Städtezeit.
note.en: Excavators found a channel with large brick covers in Block 8, Room 50. The numeric range is the contextual period of Indus urbanism.
